name: Lumen
description: Aurora Industries' academy interceptor. A slim solar-sail dart that trades armor for raw acceleration and a forgiving reactor.

name: Gale
description: The Consortium's contract gunship: a stubby delta wedge with bolt-on armor plates and a cargo pod for salvage runs.

name: Ember
description: Nova Dynasty's ceremonial striker, forged around a ring-core reactor. Its forward-swept wings hide ablative lacquer plates.

name: Wisp
description: A needle-thin courier with a single oversized drive and a sensor eye that sees heat blooms through dust clouds.

name: Prospector
description: A beetle-shelled ore hauler with a container rack spine. Slow, patient, and very hard to crack open.

name: Kestrel
description: Blade-winged pursuit craft with an exposed reactor core that glows brighter the harder it turns.

name: Pathfinder
description: A spine-frame survey vessel with folding x-struts, a deep-space dish and a long-range ion array for charting unmapped lanes.

name: Mender
description: A halo-ringed field medic whose crystal lattice armor doubles as a shield projector for its wing.

name: Bastion
description: A slab-sided monolith with no wings at all, just heavy plating, a buried reactor and a cluster drive that shoves it forward like a tide.

name: Harrow
description: Hammerhead destroyer with folded gun wings that unfold into a broadside of four barrels.

name: Umbra
description: A crescent of light-drinking ablative ceramic. It has no antenna, no running lights and, on most scanners, no existence.

name: Cipher
description: An EW needle bristling with spike emitters, built to strip shields and scramble fire-control across a whole engagement.

name: Cradle
description: A manta-winged carrier with a ring of launch cradles. Its drone wing is its gun deck; the hull itself barely bothers with turrets.

name: Sovereign
description: A trident-prowed battlecruiser with a container-rack keel and an ion array long enough to hold a small station's worth of thrust.

name: Zenith
description: A hammer-browed capital ship grown around an exposed star-core. Crystal armor refracts incoming beams into its own capacitors.

name: Riftbreaker
description: Built from salvage recovered at the Vanta Rift, this spiked crystal wedge hits like a capital ship and moves like a fighter.
